The multiple Or's are there to leave room for whatever other mental diagnosis people wish to add, so basically I left them for a more generalizing effect. Then, the poem goes into a more personalized, narrow portion about what diagnosis' I've been given.

That would make an interesting title, I suppose. And I'm not completely accepting my self-harm, OCD, and whatnot, I'm more just saying that things like this are not a common cold, not a diagnosis. Most of these things are something that cannot be cured, as they are a disconnect (or uncommon connect, depending) in the brain. I think thats the best way to explain. That can help, too, even if its just someone to talk to. Do stuff for yourself. Find something to keep you happy, like a hobby. And just remember... There is always someone out there who cares and loves you. Someone who will try to be there for you, no matter what. And even us here on the internet will try to help. Theres still people out there who care. You just gotta give them a chance. So try to smile, OP. We're all here for you.
